description: Everything needed to build a website or app on this cmssy workspace, as data: `files` (path and content of the catch-all page, editor route, proxy, config, block registry and header/footer layout regions), `dependencies` (the npm packages with their version), `env` (the variables filled in for this workspace, CMSSY_DRAFT_SECRET included - server-only), the current `previewUrl`, and `steps` in order. Read-only: it writes nothing to the workspace or to disk - the caller writes the files. Call it first whenever you build or wire a site, instead of reconstructing the setup from documentation. The steps then use set_preview_url, create_webhook, list_block_types, create_page, add_block_to_page and publish_page.

framework.description: The app framework. Only Next.js (App Router) is supported here.
